topic: Shipping a Box at the Post Office

script.title: SHIPPING A BIG BOX
script.story_hook: A box of mugs heading all the way to Denver.
script.intro_zh: 一箱馬克杯要一路送到丹佛。
script.welcome_en: Hello again, friends! Today we're shipping a box at the post office.
script.welcome_zh: 朋友們好！今天我們要在郵局寄一個包裹。
script.outro: All taped and shipped! Tune in again soon, okay?
script.outro_zh: 貼好也寄出啦！很快再一起來聽，好嗎？
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat each sentence together now, slowly.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起，慢慢地重複每一句。
script.char_a_description: a tall man in his early thirties with sandy buzzed sides and a tousled top, wearing an olive puffer vest over a flannel shirt, taping a cardboard box shut with both hands
script.char_b_description: a stout woman in her sixties with a silver chin-length bob and cat-eye glasses, wearing a burgundy cardigan and a round name badge, humming as she reaches for more tape

Follow Ethan as he asks about rates, compares ground and air, adds insurance for fragile mugs, dictates an address, and gets a tracking number on his receipt — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and use it for real.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new listening episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】📦郵局寄件英文｜詢問運費・加買保險・拿追蹤碼｜聽完就會寄包裹｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
第一次在英文櫃台寄包裹，會不會緊張？
運費、保險、追蹤號碼，到底該怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進人來人往的郵局，跟著 Ethan 從秤重報運費、挑選陸運或空運、替易碎品加買保險，一路到口述姐姐的地址、拿到收據上的追蹤號碼，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
📦 問運費與速度：例如「How much is shipping for ten pounds?」。
🛡️ 替包裹加保：例如「Do you want insurance on it too?」。
🧾 拿追蹤號碼：例如「Can I get a tracking number?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下一個要寄的包裹，換你用英文輕鬆搞定！
script.thumbnail_action: holding a taped box up at the counter

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need to ship this box to Denver.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ nid tə ʃɪp ðɪs bɑks tu ˈdɛnvər/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我要寄這個箱子到丹佛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. Is everything packed inside already?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr θɪŋ ɪz ˈɛvriθɪŋ pækt ɪnˈsaɪd ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，裡面東西都先裝好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, mostly — just some ceramic mugs, um.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈmoʊstli dʒʌst səm səˈræmɪk mʌɡz ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 大致都包好了，呃，就是一些陶瓷馬克杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mugs? Then grab a fragile sticker from the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌɡz ðɛn ɡræb ə ˈfrædʒəl ˈstɪkər frʌm ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 杯子啊？那從牆上拿一張易碎貼紙吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea… oh, this tape is running out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪdiə oʊ ðɪs teɪp ɪz ˈrʌnɪŋ aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 好主意……喔，這捲膠帶快用完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, I'll wrap it twice, hold on.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜriz aɪl ræp ɪt twaɪs hoʊd ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，我幫你纏兩層，稍等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks! How much is shipping for ten pounds?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ˈʃɪpɪŋ fɔr tɛn paʊndz/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！十磅的運費要多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ground takes four days, air takes just two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡraʊnd teɪks fɔr deɪz ɛr teɪks dʒʌst tu/
dialogue.zh: 陸運要四天，空運只要兩天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four days is fine, it's not a rush or anything.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr deɪz ɪz faɪn ɪts nɑt ə rʌʃ ɔr ˈɛniθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 四天沒關係，一點也不趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Do you want insurance on it too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt du ju wɑn ɪnˈʃʊrəns ɑn ɪt tu/
dialogue.zh: 了解。你也要幫它投保嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, these mugs were a gift… yeah, add it.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðiz mʌɡz wər ə ɡɪft jɛ æd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這些杯子是送的禮物……要，加上吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart choice. Coverage at twenty dollars?
dialogue.zh: 明智的選擇。保二十美元好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That works. Can I get a tracking number?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wərks kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈtrækɪŋ ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 可以。能給我一個追蹤號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, it prints right on your receipt here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ɪt prɪnts raɪt ɑn jɔr rɪˈsit hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，收據上就直接印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, sending gifts finally feels so easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ˈsɛndɪŋ ɡɪfts ˈfaɪnəli filz soʊ ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，送禮物終於變得這麼簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One sec, this label needs your sister's address.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn sɛk ðɪs ˈleɪbəl nidz jɔr ˈsɪstərz əˈdrɛs/
dialogue.zh: 稍等，這張單子要填你姐姐的地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh right! Here, let me dictate it slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ raɪt hɪr lɛt mi ˈdɪktet ɪt ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 對了！來，讓我慢慢唸給你聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All set! It ships today. Have a good one!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl sɛt ɪt ʃɪps təˈdeɪ hæv ə ɡʊd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 全都搞定！今天就能寄出。祝你今天愉快！
